title: A little room in the cache
brief: A cache entry is live strictly before its expiration time. Implement solve(value), returning live entry keys in input order. value contains now (integer) and entries (an array of {key: string, created: integer, ttl: nonnegative integer}). All numbers are safe integers. Entries expire at created + ttl, including the exact boundary. There are at most 100 entries. Do not mutate the input. Implement the function from this specification.

requirements.description: Return live keys in input order; preserve input.
An entry is expired when now >= created + ttl; ttl 0 expires immediately.
An empty cache returns an empty list.

hints: Think about the last instant at which an entry is still live.
Try a test with now exactly equal to created + ttl.
The live condition is now < created + ttl. Equality means expired.
explanation: Expiration defines an exclusive upper bound. Comparing now with created + ttl using < makes equality expired, handles a zero TTL, and keeps the live interval precise. A regression test at the exact boundary distinguishes < from <=.

examples.explanation: The entry is still live one second before expiration.
The entry has expired, so no keys are returned.
